title: Template:Infobox episode/doc
content:
==Description== To use this template, copy the following code and fill in the appropriate fields. ==Syntax== 
{{infobox episode
 | title       = 
 | season      = 
 | number      = 
 | image       = [e.g. "Example.jpg"]
 | imagewidth  = [e.g. "150"] [default: 210 pixels]
 | airdate     = 
 | writer      = 
 | director    = 
 | previous    = 
 | next        = 
}}
==Sample output== 
{{infobox episode
 | title       = Flower of Babel
 | season      = One
 | number      = Three
 | image       = Example.jpg
 | airdate     = Unaired
 | writer      = D. Righta
 | director    = A. di Rektour
 | previous    = Episode Two
 | next        = Episode Four
}}
Results in... {{infobox episode | title = Flower of Babel | season = One | number = Three | image = Example.jpg | airdate = Unaired | writer = D. Righta | director = A. di Rektour | previous = Episode Two | next = Episode Four }} [[Category:Infobox templates|{{PAGENAME}}]][[Category:Template documentation|{{PAGENAME}}]]
